name: page-tint-a-middle-block-stays-off-the-band
description: The ambilight sampler read a whole half of the page per edge, so a coloured block sitting in the page's horizontal middle still fell inside the left half and tinted the band beside the card. The sampler now reads a thin strip along each edge instead, so the same block no longer reaches the left run. Same navy header over a white body as page-tint-native-glow-follows-the-page-top-to-bottom, plus a blue block placed well clear of the left edge, below the header.

actions.note: the sampler reads at 125ms, then backs off, and the band crossfades in over the tint fade
GATE: the sampler produced a read

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: Native app view is on

assertions.label: the-page-really-loaded
assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the fixture with the middle block committed

assertions.label: the-band-beside-the-header-is-navy
assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the header still reaches the band, same as page-tint-native-glow-follows-the-page-top-to-bottom.

assertions.label: the-band-beside-the-middle-block-stays-light
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: the blue block sits at 30-55% of the page's width, well clear of the left strip, so the band here reads the white body, not the block. A half-of-the-page sampler would have picked the block up at this height and read visibly darker.
